! -------------------------------------------------------------
! Sample Adblock Filter List for Spec Compliance Testing
! -------------------------------------------------------------
! Comments starting with exclamation marks should be ignored
# Comments starting with hash marks should also be ignored

! --- Valid ABP Block Rules (||host^) ---
||adservice.google.com^
||analytics.tracker.net^
||telemetry.adnetwork.org^
||evil-tracker.co.uk^

! --- Valid ABP Allowlist / Exception Rules (@@||host^) ---
! Allowlist takes priority over blocklist rules
@@||safe.adservice.google.com^
@@||cdn.analytics.tracker.net^
@@||trusted.evil-tracker.co.uk^

! --- Valid Hosts Format Entries ---
0.0.0.0 bad-host.com banner.bad-host.com
127.0.0.1 malicious-tracker.net # inline comment should be stripped
::1 ipv6-adserver.com

! --- Valid Plain Domain Entries ---
plain-ad.com
popup-network.biz
spyware-domain.xyz

! --- Rules to SKIP: Path Syntax (/) ---
||example-path.com/ads/*
example-path.com/banner.js
/ad-rotator/

! --- Rules to SKIP: Wildcards (*) ---
||*click*.com^
ad*.tracking.org
*wildcard-ad*.net

! --- Rules to SKIP: Element Hiding / Cosmetic (##, #?#, #@#, #$#) ---
example.com##.sponsor-banner
###ad-frame
clean-site.org##div[class="advert"]
forum.net#@#.whitelist-banner

! --- Rules to SKIP: Option Modifiers ($domain=, $script, etc.) ---
||track.com^$domain=news.com
||script-block.com^$script,third-party
||image-ad.com^$image

! --- Rules to SKIP: Loopback / Localhost ---
127.0.0.1 localhost
::1 localhost
0.0.0.0 local

! End of test list
